authority.directive: PersonaSLM — REAL-SPEAKER EXPERIMENTAL ACCELERATION — Primary Research Direction and Execution Mandate
authority.relevant_authorization: The researcher authorizes a new, prospectively registered developmental real-speaker factorial pilot and directs execution of a small finite model experiment while retaining privacy, scientific-validity, hardware, and cumulative-budget constraints.

preserved_original.superseded_clause_for_this_pilot_only: A generation pilot is therefore blocked until a Japanese-capable, condition-blinded semantic rubric is frozen and its applicability is demonstrated.

narrow_amendment.authorized: At most 64 zero-retry generations in the prospectively frozen RealPersonaChat DEVELOPMENT exploratory 2^3 S/F/H pilot may run using only frozen automatic proxy and engineering endpoints before human semantic annotations exist.
narrow_amendment.semantic_endpoints: NOT_OBSERVED until genuine condition-blinded human judgments are collected under a separately frozen protocol; automatic proxies may not be relabeled as human or semantic Persona Fidelity.
narrow_amendment.framing: Anonymous aggregate non-impersonation research only; prompts instruct the model not to identify or claim to be a real participant.
narrow_amendment.public_data: No participant text, identifiers, prompts, references, row-level outputs, or speaker mappings may be published or staged.
narrow_amendment.reserved_splits: No exploratory-test or independent-validation persona value or utterance text may be deserialized, retained, inspected, or used for this pilot.
narrow_amendment.historical_evidence: No frozen historical experiment, threshold, outcome, or intake evidence is changed.
narrow_amendment.validation_status: The 64-request pilot remains DEVELOPMENT EXPLORATORY and cannot constitute independent validation.

still_required_before_inference: independent scientific audit of materials and measurements
frozen private material and public hash receipt
separate prospective model/execution registration and authorization
cumulative generation and inference-time budget check
not_authorized: semantic or human-reviewed claims without genuine labels
training or fine-tuning on participant records
use of held-out speaker content for development decisions
changes to the frozen v4 4-GiB experiment
